Note:
[32-bit] Header - Entry Point
The boot procedure jumps here after displaying the Nintendo logo. Contains start-up instructions for the program.
Value: 0xffff5518

[48 bytes] Header - Nintendo Logo
Contains the bitmap of the Nintendo logo that is shown during boot-up.

[15 bytes] Header - Title
15 character title.
Value: "NEWADVENTURESOF"

[8-bit] GBC Flag
Identifies if this game is GBC-only.
Value: 0xc0 (GBC-only)

[2 bytes] New Licensee Code
A 2 character code for the game's licensee.
Value: 0x3030 ("00", none)

[8-bit] Header - SGB Flag
Specifies if SGB functionality should be enabled.
Value: 0x03 (enabled)

[8-bit] Header - Cartridge Type
Specifies the cartridge's hardware.
Value: 0x1b (MBC5+RAM+BATTERY)

[8-bit] Header - ROM Size
Specifies the ROM size.
Value: 0x04 (512KB, 32 banks)

[8-bit] Header - RAM Size
Specifies the size of external RAM included in the cartridge, if any.
Value: 0x03 (32KB, 4 x 8KB banks)

[8-bit] Header - Destination Code
Specifies if the game is developed for use in either Japan or internationally.
Value: 0x00 (Japan)

[8-bit] Header - Old Lincnsee Code
Licensee Code used for older GB games. When set to 0x33, the New Licensee Code (@ 0x144) is used instead.
Value: 0x33

[8-bit] Header - Mask ROM Version Number
The version number of the game.
Value: 0x01

[8-bit] Header - Header Checksum
Must be calculated correctly for the game to work.
Value: 0xee (correct, game is functional)

[16-bit] Header - Global Checksum
Value: 0xde7c

[16-bit] Frame Counter
Freezing this (or at least the first bit of this) will cause certain game logic to also freeze and stop functioning until unfrozen.
[16-bit] Player X-Position
[16-bit] Player Y-Position

[Lower4] Player Facing Direction
Changes between 0x0 and 0x1 while in menus.
0x0 = Usually used during transitions and on the credits screen.
0x1 = Right
0x3 = Left

[8-bit] Player's Current Sprite
Will increment through the animation frames dictated by 0x00c0c5 and 0x00c0c6. Also continue incrementing when a text box is active and during transitions.
0x00 - 0x03 = Spin Jump, left
0x04 = Standing, facing right
0x05 - 0x08 = Spin Jump, right
0x09 = Standing, facing left
0x0b - 0x0c = Runinng, right
0x0f - 0x10 = Running, left

[8-bit] Player Animation - First Frame
The first frame of the player's current animation; see 0x00c0c4.

[8-bit] Player Animation - Loop Point
The index after the final frame of the player's current animation. Loops back to first frame before reaching this value. See 0x00c0c4.

[Lower4] Player Action State
The player's current action. Will also switch between 0x0, 0x1, and 0x2 in certain menus.
0x0 = Spin Jump, left
0x1 = Standing, right
0x2 = Spin Jump, right
0x3 = Standing, left
0x5 = Running, right
0x7 = Running, left

[8-Bit] Player Control State
0x01 = Disabled, usually due to a text box or menu being controlled.
0x03 = Enabled, player can be controlled.
0x17 = Unknown, used during screen transitions.

[8-bit] Current Screen/Level
OASYS Splash Screen = 0x0d
Title = 0x10
Zone 1, Act 1 = 0x06
Zone 1, Act 2 = 0x07
Zone 2, Act 1 = 0x08
Zone 2, Act 2 = 0x09
Zone 3, Act 1 = 0x0a
Zone 3, Act 2 = 0x0b
Zone Clear 1 (Thanks) = 0x0c
Zone Clear 2 (Active development) = 0x05
Zone Clear 3 (Featuring) = 0x0e
Zone Clear 4 (Starring) = 0x0f
Credits = 0x04

[8-bit][Bitflags] Input
Stores the currently pressed input. Also see 0x00c684 for current input (matches this value) and 0x00c685 for previous input.
Bit 0 = Right
Bit 1 = Left
Bit 2 = Up
Bit 3 = Down
Bit 4 = A
Bit 5 = B
Bit 6 = Select
Bit 7 = Start

[8-bit][Bitflags] Current Input
Contains input for this frame. Matches 0x00c680, see that address for values.

[8-bit][Bitflags] Previous Input
Stores the input from the previous frame, see 0x00c684 for values.

[8-Bit] Text Box Control State
0x01 = Enabled
0x19 = Disabled

[8-bit] Text Box Trigger
Used to detect which text box trigger the player is colliding with. The text box and a corresponding message will be displayed when the player enters the trigger.
0x00 = Act 1: intro text, Act 2: goal text
0x01 = Act 1: goal text
0xff = Player is not colliding with any trigger or is not in an Act.

[8-bit] Text Box Current Y-Position
See 0x00c988 for common values.

[8-bit] Text Box Target Y-Position
The y-position the text box will slide to when active.
0x60 = 4 lines of text
0x70 = 2 lines of text
0x90 = Off-screen

[64 bytes] Text Box Message
ASCII text string  for the message displayed within the text box.

[8-bit] Unknown
This was previously used for detecting ring collection, but was determined to be ineffective for that purpose.
0x00 = Ring collected... usually.
0x01 = Goal post touched; not cleared when entering next Act.
0x02 = Ring collected, sometimes and only if in Zone 2.
0x10 = Set during transitions when a Zone is cleared.

[16-bit] Ring Collection?
0x00d980 - 0x00d98f all seem to be linked to ring collection. 0x00d984 is the most consistent for detecting when a ring is collected.

[16-bit] Player X-Velocity
The player's current horizontal movement speed and direction. Value persists when a menu is open, despite the player not moving.
0x0000 = No horizontal movement
0x0001 - 0x0029 = Moving right (higher numbers = faster)
0xffd6 - 0xffff = Moving left (lower numbers = faster)

[8-bit] Player X-Movement Direction
The player's current horizontal direction.
See 0x00da5a [16-bit].
0x00 = Right (or None, if not moving horizontally)
0xff = Left

[16-bit] Player Y-Velocity
The player's current vertical movement speed and direction. Value persists when a menu is open, despite the player not moving.
0x0007 = No vertical movement (game is likely applying some downward force to keep player grounded, even when at a standstill).
0x0000 - 0x0055 = Descending (higher numbers = faster)
0xffbf - 0xffff = Ascending (lower numbers = faster)

[8-bit] Player Y-Movement Direction
The player's current vertical direction.
See 0x00da5a [16-bit].
0x00 = Down (or None, if not moving vertically)
0xff = Up

[8-bit] Text Box Cursor Position (TITLE SCREEN ONLY)
NOTE: This address technically refers to certain sprites or pixels being display, but can be used to check the position of the cursor on the title screen.
0x01 = Zone 1
0x02 = Zone 2
0x03 = Zone 3
0x04 = Credits
